---
name: Plugin request
about: Request a plugin capability that does not yet have a qualifying listing in the directory
title: "Request: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Before submitting / 提交前

- [ ] Any future qualifying release must provide a downloadable `.jar` artifact.
      任何未来的合格正式版本都必须提供可下载的 `.jar` 构件。

- [ ] I searched the current plugin directory and found no qualifying plugin for this capability.
      我已搜索当前插件目录，确认没有提供该能力的合格插件。
- [ ] I searched open and closed issues for the same or substantially similar request.
      我已搜索已开启和已关闭的 issue，确认没有相同或实质相似的请求。
- [ ] If a similar issue already exists, I will add context there instead of opening a duplicate.
      如果已存在相似 issue，我会在该 issue 下补充上下文，而不是重复开启新 issue。

## Requested capability / 请求的功能

What plugin capability are you requesting?
你希望获得什么插件能力？

## Concrete use case / 具体使用场景

Describe the real scenario where this capability is needed.
描述你需要该能力的真实场景。

## Expected behavior / 预期行为

What should a qualifying plugin be able to do?
符合收录条件的插件应当具备哪些能力？

## Existing alternatives / 现有替代方案

List existing plugins, workarounds, or manual processes you currently rely on.
列出你当前依赖的现有插件、变通方案或手动流程。
